details.q: How many orders are there in total?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders FROM orders
details.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM orders

details.q: What is the total revenue from paid orders?
details.sql: SELECT SUM(total_amount) AS total_revenue FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
details.gold: SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status='paid'

details.q: How many distinct customers have placed at least one order?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders
details.gold: SELECT count(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM orders

details.q: What is the average order amount for paid orders?
details.sql: SELECT AVG(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
details.gold: SELECT avg(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status='paid'

details.q: List revenue by city for paid orders.
details.sql:
SELECT c.city, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY revenue DESC
details.gold: SELECT c.city, sum(o.total_amount) v FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY 1

details.q: List revenue by product category for paid orders.
details.sql:
SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price - oi.discount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY p.category
details.gold: SELECT p.category, sum(oi.qty*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)) v FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY 1

details.q: What is the average order value (AOV) by customer segment for paid orders?
details.sql:
SELECT c.segment, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.segment
details.gold: SELECT c.segment, sum(o.total_amount)/count(DISTINCT o.order_id) v FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY 1

details.q: Show monthly revenue for paid orders in 2025.
details.sql:
SELECT strftime(o.order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue
FROM orders o
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY strftime(o.order_date, '%Y-%m')
ORDER BY month
details.gold: SELECT strftime(order_date,'%Y-%m') m, sum(total_amount) v FROM orders WHERE status='paid' AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

details.q: Which 5 products have the highest total quantity sold?
details.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.name, SUM(oi.qty) AS total_qty
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY total_qty DESC
LIMIT 5
details.gold: SELECT p.name, sum(oi.qty) v FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

details.q: How many customers have never placed an order?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.order_id IS NULL
details.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id=c.customer_id)

details.q: What is the refund rate by channel (refunded orders / all orders)?
details.sql:
SELECT o.channel, COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS refund_rate
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY o.channel
details.gold: SELECT channel, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN status='refunded' THEN order_id END)*1.0/count(DISTINCT order_id) v FROM orders GROUP BY 1

details.q: List total refund amount by reason.
details.sql: SELECT reason, SUM(amount) AS total_refund_amount FROM refunds GROUP BY reason
details.gold: SELECT reason, sum(amount) v FROM refunds GROUP BY 1

details.q: Which city has the highest total refund amount?
details.sql:
SELECT c.city, SUM(r.amount) AS total_refund
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY total_refund DESC
LIMIT 1
details.gold: SELECT c.city, sum(r.amount) v FROM refunds r JOIN orders o USING(order_id) JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

details.q: Show the number of orders per month for each channel in 2025.
details.sql:
SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, channel, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM orders
WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY month, channel
ORDER BY month, channel
details.gold: SELECT strftime(order_date,'%Y-%m') m, channel, count(*) v FROM orders WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

details.q: What is the total gross margin (revenue minus product cost) for paid orders?
details.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price - oi.qty * p.cost) AS total_gross_margin
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
details.gold: SELECT sum(oi.qty*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)) - sum(oi.qty*p.cost) v FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) WHERE o.status='paid'

details.q: Which customers have placed more than 10 paid orders?
details.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS paid_order_count
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
HAVING COUNT(o.order_id) > 10
details.gold: SELECT c.name, count(*) v FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) > 10

details.q: What is the average discount rate across all order items?
details.sql: SELECT AVG(discount) AS avg_discount_rate FROM order_items
details.gold: SELECT avg(discount) FROM order_items

details.q: List the top 3 brands by revenue in the Electronics category.
details.sql:
SELECT p.brand, SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price - oi.discount) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE p.category = 'Electronics' AND o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY p.brand
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 3
details.gold: SELECT p.brand, sum(oi.qty*oi.unit_price*(1-oi.discount)) v FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.status='paid' AND p.category='Electronics' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

details.q: How many orders were refunded but have no record in the refunds table?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id WHERE o.status = 'refunded' AND r.refund_id IS NULL
details.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.status='refunded' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.order_id)

details.q: What is the median order amount for paid orders?
details.sql: SELECT median(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid'
details.gold: SELECT median(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status='paid'

details.q: List each segment's share of total paid revenue (as a fraction).
details.sql:
SELECT c.segment, SUM(o.total_amount) / (SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid') AS revenue_share
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.segment
details.gold: SELECT c.segment, sum(o.total_amount)/(SELECT sum(total_amount) FROM orders WHERE status='paid') v FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY 1

details.q: For each category, how many distinct customers bought it?
details.sql:
SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS distinct_customers
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
GROUP BY p.category
details.gold: SELECT p.category, count(DISTINCT o.customer_id) v FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi USING(order_id) JOIN products p USING(product_id) GROUP BY 1

details.q: What is the month-over-month growth rate of paid revenue in 2025?
details.sql:
SELECT month, revenue, (revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month)) / LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM (
    SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(total_amount) AS revenue
    FROM orders
    WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m')
) t
ORDER BY month
details.gold: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(order_date,'%Y-%m') m, sum(total_amount) v FROM orders WHERE status='paid' AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31' GROUP BY 1) SELECT m, (v - lag(v) OVER (ORDER BY m))/lag(v) OVER (ORDER BY m) g FROM m ORDER BY 1

details.q: Which product category has the highest average item price?
details.sql: SELECT p.category, AVG(oi.unit_price) AS avg_item_price FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY avg_item_price DESC LIMIT 1
details.gold: SELECT p.category, avg(oi.unit_price) v FROM order_items oi JOIN products p USING(product_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 1

details.q: How many orders in 2025 have a total amount greater than 500?
details.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND order_date < DATE '2026-01-01' AND total_amount > 500
details.gold: SELECT count(*) FROM orders WHERE total_amount > 500 AND order_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'

details.q: List the number of new customers signed up per quarter in 2024.
details.sql:
SELECT date_trunc('quarter', signup_date) AS quarter, COUNT(*) AS new_customers
FROM customers
WHERE signup_date >= DATE '2024-01-01' AND signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY quarter
ORDER BY quarter
details.gold: SELECT quarter(signup_date) q, count(*) v FROM customers WHERE year(signup_date)=2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

details.q: What percentage of paid orders used the app channel?
details.sql:
SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN channel = 'app' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS app_paid_order_pct
FROM orders
WHERE status = 'paid'
details.gold: SELECT count(CASE WHEN channel='app' THEN 1 END)*1.0/count(*) v FROM orders WHERE status='paid'

details.q: List each customer's most recent order date.
details.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.name, MAX(o.order_date) AS most_recent_order_date
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.name
details.gold: SELECT customer_id, max(order_date) v FROM orders GROUP BY 1

details.q: What is the total quantity sold for products that have never been refunded?
details.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.qty) AS total_quantity_sold
FROM order_items oi
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE p.product_id NOT IN (
    SELECT oi2.product_id
    FROM order_items oi2
    JOIN refunds r ON oi2.order_id = r.order_id
)
details.gold: SELECT sum(oi.qty) v FROM order_items oi WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM refunds r JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.order_id=oi.order_id AND r.amount > 0)

details.q: Which three cities have the highest average order value for paid orders?
details.sql:
SELECT c.city, AVG(o.total_amount) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
GROUP BY c.city
ORDER BY avg_order_value DESC
LIMIT 3
details.gold: SELECT c.city, sum(o.total_amount)/count(DISTINCT o.order_id) v FROM orders o JOIN customers c USING(customer_id) WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3
